issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one implemented Observatory redesign backed by authentic Runtime projections.

## Primary deliverable

One implemented Observatory redesign consuming authentic Runtime projections.

## Verification result

Exact browser, accessibility, redaction, recovery, and authentic Runtime-route checks pass.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one implemented Observatory redesign; browser and authority cases are proof inputs.

## Dependencies

- OBS-A: #511
- Sprint 8 coordination: #536

Issue #84 is independent backlog work and is not a dependency or execution gate for #512.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] OBS-A contracts are implemented
- [ ] Runtime projections are source-grounded
- [ ] Accessibility and recovery cases pass
- [ ] No mock substitutes for the required Runtime route

## Owned paths

- `demos/html-observatory/app.js`
- `demos/html-observatory/styles.css`
- `adl/tools/validate_layer8_authority_observatory_ui.sh`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/observatory/obs-b/**`

## PVF lanes

- `authentic-runtime-route`
- `exact-browser-cases`
- `accessibility`
- `redaction`
- `recovery`

## Stop conditions

- Issue #511 is not reviewed and terminal
- A mock substitutes for the required Runtime route

## Non-goals

- TLS 1.2 implementation owned by issue #251
- Public exposure owned by issue #122
- Unity integration owned by independent backlog issue #84
